facts: RootExtraction_MACRO task 2 consumes noddrz and cumdens_top to distribute ptra over rooted compartments.
initialize_rootdistribution calls update_cumdens_top at crop emergence.
update_rootdistribution calls update_cumdens_top again during crop/root development.
update_cumdens_top recomputes cumulative fractions using the current noddrz and compartment depths.
adaptive root distribution can additionally update the normalized cumulative root-density curve before cumdens_top is rebuilt.

correction_to_readiness_inventory.previous_classification: cumdens_top/rooted node distribution listed as immutable process parameter
correction_to_readiness_inventory.corrected_classification: rooted_nodes and current normalized cumulative root fractions are dynamic crop-derived process inputs for each root-uptake evaluation

candidate_action: Move rooted_nodes and cumulative_root_fraction from root_water_uptake_parameters_t into root_water_uptake_request_t before owner qualification.
